story.fullStory:
Mötley Crüe's "Shout At The Devil" — original release 1983. Shout at the Devil is the second album by the American heavy metal band Mötley Crüe, released on September 23, 1983.

Artist: Mötley Crüe · Title: Shout At The Devil · Album: Afraid · Year: 1997 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Mötley Crüe - Shout At The Devil.mp4.

It was the band's breakthrough album, establishing Mötley Crüe as one of the top-selling heavy metal acts of the 1980s.

The singles "Looks That Kill", "Too Young to Fall in Love" and "Shout at the Devil" were moderate hits for the band.

evidence.recording:
2 recording notes captured

Just prior to returning home to Los Angeles to begin recording the album, Mötley Crüe had a brief five show support spot on Kiss' Creatures of the Night tour.

During recording, bassist Sixx was involved in a serious car crash after drunkenly stealing a friend's Porsche in Los Angeles.
